title: fedcausal: federated Bayesian network structure learning and causal discovery
description: fedcausal learns causal structure from data split across sites that cannot share them. In FedGES each site runs greedy equivalence search on its own data, a coordinator fuses the resulting graphs, and only graphs and scores leave the sites; it takes discrete and continuous data. FedRCD recovers a causal order and linear coefficients under a linear non-Gaussian model from moment sums that each site computes on its own rows. Both run in one process for experiments or over Flower across machines. It is built on causalbase.
